title: Rest client ignores default tls configuration
body:
### Describe the bug

I have an application, which uses rest client to connect to a https server with self-signed certificate. I use truststore so client could connect to the server. When I use old-style properties[1] or named tls configuration[2], the app works as expected. When I use default configuration (the guide [2] says "If not set and the default TLS configuration is configured (quarkus.tls.*) then that will be used." ), the client fails with PKIX path building failure.

[1] https://quarkus.io/guides/rest-client#quarkus-rest-client-config_quarkus-rest-client-trust-store
[2] https://quarkus.io/guides/rest-client#quarkus-rest-client-config_quarkus-rest-client-tls-configuration-name

### Expected behavior

Behavior, described in a guide, should work.

### How to Reproduce?

1. Clone the reproducer `git clone -b tls-config-default https://github.com/fedinskiy/reproducer & cd reproducer` 
2. Generate the certs `quarkus tls generate-certificate --name my-cert --self-signed && rm .env`
3. Start the app using old properties: `mvn clean quarkus:dev -Dquarkus.profile=old`
4. Check, that the client works:
```
$ curl -k https://localhost:8443 
Received: Hello from Quarkus REST
```
5. Start the app with named tls configuration: `mvn clean quarkus:dev -Dquarkus.profile=new`
6. Check, that the client works:
```
$ curl -k https://localhost:8443 
Received: Hello from Quarkus REST
```
7. Start the app, using default configuration: `mvn clean quarkus:dev -Dquarkus.profile=dflt`
8. The request from the client fails:
```
 curl -k https://localhost:8443 

500 - Internal Server Error
---------------------------

Details:
<see the full stacktrace above>
```

### Output of `uname -a` or `ver`

6.14.4-300.fc42.x86_64

### Output of `java -version`

21.0.5, vendor: Eclipse Adoptium

### Quarkus version or git rev

3.22.1

### Build tool (ie. output of `mvnw --version` or `gradlew --version`)

Apache Maven 3.9.6

### Additional information

Properties' profiles look like this:

```
%new.quarkus.tls.cli-conf.trust-store.p12.path=.certs/my-cert-truststore.p12
%new.quarkus.tls.cli-conf.trust-store.p12.password=password
%new.quarkus.rest-client.hello.tls-configuration-name=cli-conf

%dflt.quarkus.tls.trust-store.p12.path=.certs/my-cert-truststore.p12
%dflt.quarkus.tls.trust-store.p12.password=password

%old.quarkus.rest-client.hello.trust-store=.certs/my-cert-truststore.p12
%old.quarkus.rest-client.hello.trust-store-password=password
```
